title: Introduction to clover
text: Base-calling error rates reflect RNA modifications cause nanopore basecaller misidentify bases. Comparing error profiles conditions can reveal modification changes. Base-calling error profiles selected tRNAs.
code: bcerror <- S4Vectors::metadata(se)$bcerror  # Focus on charged tRNAs (not uncharged variants) bcerror_charged <- bcerror |>   filter(!grepl("-uncharged$", ref))  # Calculate mean error rate per position per condition bcerror_charged <- bcerror_charged |>   mutate(condition = ifelse(grepl("ctl", sample_id), "ctl", "inf"))  bcerror_summary <- bcerror_charged |>   group_by(ref, pos, condition) |>   summarise(     mean_error = mean(error_rate),     mean_mis = mean(mis),     .groups = "drop"   ) # Plot error profiles for a few tRNAs plot_trnas <- c(   "host-tRNA-Ala-GGC-1-1",   "host-tRNA-Asp-GTC-1-1",   "host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1" )  plot_bcerror_profile(bcerror_summary, refs = plot_trnas)

title: Introduction to clover
text: Difference mean base-calling error (inf - ctl) across tRNAs positions.
code: # Compute delta (inf - ctl) bcerror_delta <- bcerror_summary |>   select(ref, pos, condition, mean_error) |>   pivot_wider(names_from = condition, values_from = mean_error) |>   mutate(delta = inf - ctl)  # Add Sprinzl coordinates for position ordering sprinzl <- read_sprinzl_coords(   clover_example("sprinzl/ecoliK12_global_coords.tsv.gz") )  # Match tRNA names: strip "host-" prefix bcerror_delta <- bcerror_delta |>   mutate(trna_id = sub("^host-", "", ref))  # Join with sprinzl coords to get structural labels bcerror_sprinzl <- bcerror_delta |>   left_join(     sprinzl |> select(trna_id, seq_index, sprinzl_label),     by = c("trna_id", "pos" = "seq_index")   ) |>   filter(!is.na(sprinzl_label))  plot_mod_heatmap(   bcerror_sprinzl,   value_col = "delta",   ref_col = "ref",   color_limits = c(-0.1, 0.1) )

title: Introduction to clover
text: MODOMICS database catalogs known RNA modifications. modomics_mods() maps known tRNA modification positions onto reference sequences using pairwise alignment. Data common organisms bundled package (see modomics_organisms()), internet connection needed. can overlay known modifications onto base-calling error profiles. Positions known modifications often correspond elevated error rates, since basecaller misidentifies modified nucleotides. Base-calling error profiles known modification positions marked.

title: Introduction to clover
text: Sprinzl coordinate files use RNA anticodon notation (e.g., UUC) pipeline uses DNA notation (e.g., TTC). pipeline also adds host- prefix. need account naming differences matching. Modification co-occurrence network single tRNA one sample.
code: # Pick one tRNA and one sample or_single <- or_data |>   filter(     ref == "host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1",     sample_id == "wt-15-ctl-01"   )  # Get sprinzl coords: note UUC (RNA) vs TTC (DNA) in anticodon sprinzl_glu <- sprinzl |>   filter(trna_id == "tRNA-Glu-UUC-1-1")  # Filter modifications for this tRNA mods_glu <- mods |>   filter(ref == "host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1")  plot_chord_or(   or_single,   or_cutoff = 1.0,   p_cutoff = 0.01,   min_obs = 100,   sprinzl_coords = sprinzl_glu,   mods = mods_glu,   title = "host-tRNA-Glu-TTC-1-1 (ctl-01)" )
